Thanks for the loop Marissa / Rajiv. Quick guidance from Redwood legal:

- Sequencing: NDA -> Security questionnaire + DPA drafting (we often provide DPA language as a separate schedule) -> MSA redline loop. Doing the DPA early helps speed SOC2 evidence and data processing conversations.
- Turn times: typical first-pass review from Redwood legal on a vendor counter-redline is ~3 business days for standard edits, 5-7 business days if there are substantive commercial changes. If Acme provides heavily redlined terms (indemnities/caps/termination fees) expect iteration.
- Recommended approach: ask Acme to return a single consolidated redline (MSA + DPA in one doc) if possible - reduces back-and-forth. If procurement requires clause-level escalation, please surface early.

I can own the Redwood side once they return redlines; Rajiv, feel free to send counter redlines to legal@redwood.com and I will prioritize. If you need expedited review, let me/Aditya know - we can request a one-off SLA.
